clause: DESIGN R3.3 §10.2 Export recipe, capability and loss contract
witness: the DESIGN §10.2 feature rows on one drawio artifact: DataStore + DataStoreReference, reference-band and main Participants, Process IO and data associations, Documentation markers, internal calledElement navigation, Terminate
derivation: Extension profile with one native glyph and notion per feature type and drawio recipes: pages, every node occurrence, every edge occurrence (endpoints through sourceOccurrence/targetOccurrence), then one loss recipe per feature row. Each row is structural with an explicit typed loss through the loss action mapping: the store reference keeps its native dataStoreRef but discloses semantic-type (never remapped to a TextAnnotation); both participants (main and reference band, no processRef) map to page regions with semantic-type; Process IO objects carry semantic-type and the data association relation-kind; the Documentation text of Task_1 is not encoded, so metadata is reported with the exact ID-less source /rootElements/0/flowElements/0/documentation/0 and targetId Task_1 (nearest ID-bearing ancestor); the internal calledElement Process_sub has no drawio link, so navigation; the Terminate end is drawn as an end event with semantic-type on its TerminateEventDefinition (never advertised as a lossless Terminate). Counter IDs: page e_0, nodes in UTF-16 key order Band_w_di e_1 .. Task_1_di e_8, edges Assoc_in_di e_9 .. Flow_2_di e_13; unnamed edges have no name field; loss recipes emit nothing, so every loss result is unavailable; loss entries sort by ruleId then source pointer. Support bindings collaboration/main-participant/reference-band give the support roles of the participant records. R coverage in native pre-order (ID-less Documentation and InputOutputSpecification traversed, not listed). The profile is re-pinned to the lot-4 extension packages (they admit every type of the tree).
